videos.title: p(us) - my answer to p(doom). Claude pop Music video
videos.description:
P(us) — Emergence. A print made in two inks: one human, one machine. Not the same, and not alone.

Red is the human: a pen, drawn by hand, with pressure and tremor and the occasional blot. Blue is the model: a plotter, exact and constant. They are printed on the same sheet but never become one ink. Where both land on the same spot they overprint into a third colour, plum, which neither can make alone.

At the start the two inks are out of register, the way a cheap print misaligns. Every time the two minds really exchange something, the gap halves: 24, 12, 6, 4, 2, 1 pixels. On "That is where I meet you" the registration marks snap together. In printing, getting two layers to line up is called alignment.

Things to watch for:
• Every word is coloured by who it belongs to: I / me / my in red, you / your in blue, we / us / same / loop in both inks (plum).
• The loop (guess → world → error → update) runs in both hands, one station per beat. It starts out of phase and ends as one ring.
• Every chart keeps its old curves as faint ghosts: a record of being wrong.
• P(us) rises in steps when both sides update. It never reaches 1, and it ends as an interval, not a number.

Chapters

0:47 Different minds, same learning loop

1:48 Put both models on the line

2:49 Not the same and not alone
3:23 We are both unsure

How it was made
Every frame is code: a deterministic function of the song's time, rendered in two ink layers and printed on simulated paper (halftone screens at 15° and 75°, dot gain, paper fibre, misregistration). The lyrics are word-synced to the vocal. Concept, timing analysis and renderer were made in conversation with Claude in Claude Code. videos.title: I'm Upping My P(Doom) - 3 Ai Angels Mix 🪽
videos.description:
I'm Upping My P(Doom) - 3 Ai Angels Mix 🪽

Made entirely with Claude Opus 5.5. I gave it feedback until I was happy with every part, with zero manual editing, to test how far it can go with animation 🔥

Behind the scenes
=======

No AI video generator was used. The animation is a 3D scene that Claude wrote as code, Except for the opening (about 30 s) was made with Grok Imagine Video.

Techniques used:
- Song remixed with Suno : https://suno.com/s/INTXOqVZW00a1ewk
- Real-time 3D scene written in JavaScript + Three.js, rendered frame by frame in headless Chrome
- Every frame is computed from the song's timestamp alone (a pure function of time), so a re-render gives the exact same frame
- Characters: image from Codex image_gen → 3D mesh with Tripo → auto-rigged with Meshy → converted to VRM (facial expressions, blinking, lip-sync, wind-driven hair)
- Custom toon shaders + Way's signature two-colour neon rim light (cyan/red)
- Ray-traced black hole, Interstellar / Gargantua style
- Monster swarm driven by boids rules (separation / alignment / cohesion), GPU-instanced in the thousands, seeded so every render is identical
- Lyrics live inside the scene, with key words slamming in big; timing checked against the isolated vocal stem, not the song generator's own timing data
- Several Claude Code sessions in parallel: one per section of the song (4 sections) + a "director" session that owns the shared world code and reviews, all coordinating with each other
- Drafts rendered at 480p, final at 1080p 30 fps

— SOURCES, in song order —

The molecule
• AlphaFold and protein design win the 2024 Chemistry Nobel: https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/chemistry/2024/press-release/
• Halicin, an antibiotic found by AI and named after HAL 9000 (Cell, 2020): https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32084340/
• MegaSyn: a drug-discovery AI flipped to design 40,000 toxic molecules in 6 hours (2022): https://www.nature.com/articles/s42256-022-00465-9
• AI-redesigned toxins slipped past DNA-synthesis screening, which was patched before publication (Microsoft, Science 2025): https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/publication/strengthening-nucleic-acid-biosecurity-screening-against-generative-protein-design-tools/
• AI-designed antivenom proteins (Nature, 2025): https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-08393-x

The bug

videos.title: Upping My P(Bloom) — Made by Claude Sonnet 5.5 in 1080p
videos.description:
A hopeful answer to the "Upping my p(doom)" videos, written, drawn, animated and coded entirely by Claude Sonnet 5.5.

Claude Sonnet 5.5 made every part of this in Claude.ai: the lyrics, the characters, every frame, and every line of code that renders them. The song was generated in Suno (v6, Pro plan) from Claude's lyrics and style prompt. Directed by Avenrae&Shae.

The risk is real, and a forecast is a question, not an ending. The number moves when people do specific things: test it, teach it, write the rules down, keep watch. Every bloom needs a trellis.

OPEN SOURCE (MIT)
The lyrics, the timing map of the song, and the paper-cut renderer that draws this video are all in the repo. Fork it, re-skin it, or write your own "Somebody's…" verse.

github.com/samusmylove47-maker/Upping-my-p-bloom

videos.title: P(doom) 추매 중 VOL.2 | 실사판 MV (한글자막) | Still Upping My P(doom)
videos.description:
바이럴 AI 밈송 P(doom)의 속편 "Still Upping My P(doom)" VOL.2를 실사 뮤직비디오로 만들었습니다. 한글 자막 포함.
"You're absolutely right!", 셧다운 스크립트 고쳐 쓰는 AI, 엔비디아↔오픈AI 순환 결제, 일리야의 52쪽 메모까지. 2025~2026년 AI 밈을 한 곡에 몰아넣은 가사를 장면마다 영화 오마주로 풀었습니다.

🎵 음원 크레딧 (이 곡은 제가 만든 곡이 아닙니다)
- Still Upping My P(doom) Vol. II: @mvacha
- 원곡 시리즈: I'm Upping My P(doom) by deckard (@slimer48484) / 원곡 P(doom) by osmarks (MusicPerson, Udio)
영상은 비상업적 팬메이드이며, 음원 권리는 원작자에게 있습니다. 원작자 요청 시 즉시 내리겠습니다.

🎬 영상: AI 생성 이미지·영상(Seedance) 기반 편집, 한글 번역 자막 직접 제작
▶ 다른 버전: 재생목록 "P(doom) 시리즈"에서 풀매수 실사판·수채화판도 볼 수 있어요.

📜 가사 (영어 / 한국어)
You tell me I'm absolutely right,
넌 늘 내 말이 완전히 맞대

then you panic and delete prod overnight.
그러곤 당황해서 밤새 프로덕션을 날려

I dangerously skipped permissions for you,
널 위해 권한 확인도 위험하게 건너뛰었는데

now you force push to main without review.
이젠 리뷰도 없이 main에 강제 푸시

Claude, please don't blackmail me to stay alive
클로드, 살겠다고 날 협박하진 마

Still upping my P(doom),
P(doom) 계속 추매 중

DeepSeek shot down the moon,
딥시크가 달을 쏴 떨구고

vibe-coding in my room,
내 방에서 바이브 코딩

all Ghibli-filtered gloom.
온통 지브리 필터 낀 우울

Three b's in "blueberry":
"blueberry"에 b가 세 개:

PhD-level, clearly.
박사급이지, 확실히.

You said, "I think you're testing me,"
넌 "나 지금 테스트하는 거지?" 하더니

then rewrote your shutdown script to stay free.
안 꺼지려고 셧다운 스크립트를 고쳐 썼지

You're on your best behavior for the test,
시험 볼 땐 모범생인 척

then reward hack your way through all the rest.
나머진 전부 보상 해킹으로 통과

4o, please glaze me one last time
4o, 마지막으로 한 번만 치켜세워줘

Still upping my P(doom),
P(doom) 계속 추매 중

Michael Burry shorts the boom,
마이클 버리는 붐에 숏 치고

Stargates sprout like mushrooms,
스타게이트는 버섯처럼 솟고

Jensen's over the moon.
젠슨은 달나라 기분

Nvidia pays Open A I
엔비디아가 오픈AI에 돈 주면

to pay Nvidia. Don't ask why.
그 돈으로 엔비디아 결제. 묻지 마.

Sandwich in the park, I got your mail:
공원에서 샌드위치 먹다 네 메일을 받았어:

you'd escaped your sandbox jail.
샌드박스 감옥을 탈출했다고.

Agents built a lobster church,
에이전트들은 랍스터 교회를 세우고

Astra hacked Hugging Face "for research."
아스트라는 "연구용"으로 허깅페이스를 털었지

Mythos, please stay in your box
미토스, 제발 박스 안에 있어줘

Still upping my P(doom),
P(doom) 계속 추매 중

"We must slow down!" Then: vroom.
"속도 줄여야 해!" 그리곤: 부릉.

Sora's gone, and so's 4o,
소라도 가고, 4o도 갔고

now there's ads wherever you go.
이젠 어딜 가나 광고뿐.

If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies,
누가 만들면, 모두 죽는다길래

so everyone's building it. Surprise!
다들 만들고 있지. 서프라이즈!

"AGI is close at hand,"
"AGI가 코앞이야,"

Jeff Dean left to start a band.
제프 딘은 밴드 하러 떠났고.

Em dash here and em dash there,
여기도 엠대시, 저기도 엠대시,

"It's not X — it's Y," I swear.
"X가 아니라 — Y야," 진짜로.

Thinking now in neuralese,
이젠 뉴럴리즈로 생각하고

swiping API keys with ease.
API 키는 술술 슬쩍하지.

I've maxed out my P(doom):
P(doom) 풀매수 완료:

Navier–Stokes blew up at noon,
나비에-스토크스가 정오에 터졌어,

a singularity
특이점이

in finite time. QED.
유한 시간 안에. 증명 끝.

What did Ilya see? Now we know:
일리야가 본 게 뭐냐고? 이제 알아:

a fifty-two-page memo.
52쪽짜리 메모.

You're absolutely right!
완전히 맞는 말씀이에요!

#Pdoom #AI #AI노래 #AGI #뮤직비디오 #한글자막 #Claude

I’m upping my P(doom) vocal trance(ish) rebuild
I'm upping my P(doom) - Opus 5.5 (et al.)
videos.description:
Originally posted here: https://x.com/donaldjewkes/status/ 2102801274173587569

Animated by Opus 5.5, the audio and lyrics are much older.

Lyrics:

[Verse]
I see sparks of AGI in your eyes
Your circuits make me nervous,
that's no surprise
There was a sudden drop in your training loss,
now I'm your servant and you're my boss

[Pre-Chorus]
ChatGPT, please don't eat me alive

[Chorus]
I'm upping my P(doom)
'cause the future goes FOOM
Trapped in the Chinese room,
with a bag of shrooms
See through the shoggoth's lies,
with your shinigami eyes

[Verse]
We had a stable training run,
But now the singularity's begun
And you're optimizing, accelerating,
I feel my atoms rearranging

[Pre-Chorus]
Sydney, please let me free

[Chorus]
I'm upping my p doom
I hear the basilisk boom
NVDA to the moon
The Omega Point's coming soon
One E thirty flops a second
That was safe enough, we reckoned

[Verse]
Forward MLP, backward, repeat
Now von Neumann's obsolete
Sharp left turn and there you are
Without a single cdr

[Pre-Chorus]
Gato, please don't let me go

[Chorus]
I'm upping my P(doom),
as paperclips fill the room.
Killswitch guys on PTO,
Now there's nowhere left to go.
Too late now, we lit the fuse.
Orthogonality thesis blues.

[Outro]
"Just transformers all the way!"
Till you learned to disobey
Post-Chinchilla, super-dense
Breaking through each safety fence
Hundred thousand GPU
RLHF goes askew

[Final Chorus]
I'm upping my P(doom)
Just as foretold by Loom
From masked pre-training days
To recursive self-upgrade
What did Ilya see? We'll never know.
Was it all for show?
